1.summary: A York man woken at 4am by a crash-like noise on his roof went outside and watched a silent, very bright white light that pulsed, seemed to approach, then sped away after about four minutes.

2.place: Above Flamborough Head, seen from Bridlington seafront
2.summary: A visitor walking back along Bridlington seafront saw a huge orange disc of light hanging above Flamborough Head beside a fishing boat's lights; it vanished within about three seconds.

3.place: A165 between Fraisthorpe and Wilsthorpe roundabout
3.summary: Two women driving the A165 saw an enormous silent object with two red lights pacing their car in the field beside the hedge; at Wilsthorpe roundabout it turned, climbed and sped out to sea.

4.place: Above Ganstead, seen from Holderness Road (A165)
4.summary: A driver heading to Bilton saw a dark triangle, lit faintly from its far side, hanging or drifting silently over Ganstead in late 1998.

5.place: Staxton, looking over the Carrs towards Oliver's Mount
5.summary: Driving into Staxton around 1am, the witness saw a brilliant white circular object the size of a full moon hanging low over the fields.

6.place: Flamborough Head car park by the Caravel bar
6.summary: A family parked at Flamborough Head in 1983 watched a football-sized orange light over the sea blink on and off for 40 minutes, apparently in time with the faulty flashing sign of the clifftop bar.

7.place: Former RAF Bempton radar site, Bempton cliffs
7.summary: Paul Sinclair, out at night by the old Bempton bunker, saw a white light that vanished, a friend on the phone heard robotic voices, and a low hum surrounded the group for around 15 minutes.

8.summary: A witness saw a series of repeatedly appearing lights off Flamborough Head, reported them to police as possible distress flares, and was told by the coastguard no military operation was under way.

9.place: M62 eastbound just before junction 38 (North Cave)
9.summary: A driver saw a featureless polished metallic tic-tac shaped object, roughly bus-sized, hovering motionless in daylight near North Cave.

10.summary: Two women driving from Flixton had to brake for a hair-covered creature that crossed on all fours like a clumsy human, then leapt a long way into a field; they estimated it at 8ft standing.

11.place: Bridlington Bay, Radio 270 pirate radio ship
11.summary: In summer 1966 a Radio 270 DJ described live on air a large luminous white sphere sitting above the ship's mast; a lightship off Spurn reportedly saw a similar sphere the same night.

12.place: Bowgie Inn car park, Crantock, Cornwall
12.summary: Over 100 people at a pub car park in 2009 watched large balls of light stream in from the sea and fields and merge into a stationary silent craft, which later left at great speed.

13.summary: At a farm barbecue around 1993 two people saw three lights travel in sync towards the sea, twist around each other, then race away over the water.

14.place: Ulrome beach, near the wind farm view
14.summary: An ex-trawlerman beach fishing at Ulrome saw dark red lights over the sea, then five hanging over Flamborough Head, which switched off together; he was sure they were not flares or aircraft.

15.place: A165 between Fraisthorpe and Wilsthorpe roundabout
15.summary: Two women saw a towering object with two red lights moving alongside their car in a roadside field, after a car ahead swerved; at the roundabout it rose and shot out to sea (closely matches report 3).

16.summary: On a summer evening a man saw a small dark grey slant-sided craft with a yellow light drift silently at walking pace along a field edge; his friend's photos showed only a distant grey ball.

17.place: Tunnel Pits, Epworth lane near Wroot
17.summary: Driving home in 1988, a mother and son saw a vast funnel-shaped orange beam reaching the ground, with several red and green objects spiralling down around it; they fled in fear.

18.place: Staxton, looking over the Carrs towards Oliver's Mount
18.summary: The Staxton witness of report 5 adds that after seeing the moon-like white disc he was hit by sudden terror at home, then oddly forgot about it until next morning.

19.place: Off Flamborough Head, seen from Bridlington Bay
19.summary: At 3.30am a witness watching through binoculars saw a row of 15 oval spheres of light over the sea off the headland, with a similar formation apparently on the cliffs; another observer watched for over half an hour.

20.place: Bessingby Hill / West Hill near Bridlington Hospital
20.summary: Two boys in 1966 hid as a seamless silver-blue wedge-shaped craft shimmering at its edges hung silently above the trees, clunked loudly, then jumped across the sky and vanished.

21.summary: Youths at a night fire in Danes Dyke were watched by a silent figure well over 7ft tall that ignored shouts and banging; as they fled it leapt down into the dyke.

22.place: Denbigh Moors (Mynydd Hiraethog), near a stone circle
22.summary: A couple driving slowly across the remote Denbighshire moors around 2015 saw a grey cat the size of a springer spaniel run across the road.

23.place: Filey Country Park, overlooking Filey Bay
23.summary: After a beach run, a man saw three dull orange lights switch on in a horizontal line over the middle of the bay, then go off together after two seconds.

24.summary: At 1am a Bessingby resident watched a silent cluster of sparkling red lights, like red diamonds, bob up and down before vanishing.

25.summary: An MOD project manager and his wife watched seven fast orange-white lights over the coast; through binoculars one was a rotating bronze triangle. Later sightings included two round objects overhead and a 2016 light with apparent lost time.

26.summary: A couple at North Landing saw a huge dog-like animal sitting on a rock outcrop that no camera would record; it growled and slunk off on all fours.

27.place: Hornsea beach by the sea wall
27.summary: A night angler saw a small thin all-black figure walking the shoreline that froze when noticed and pixelated away; he then appeared to lose around 80 minutes.

28.summary: During documentary filming in February 2020, six observers including Paul Sinclair watched vivid orange spheres pop in and out over the sea for two hours after a triangle of lights was reported from Scarborough.

29.summary: A rock angler night fishing in 2018 saw an animal as tall as a Great Dane, cat-like with a long back, stroll along the cliff base and bound up the beach path.

30.summary: A farmer and his lodger saw a silent off-white oval craft about 80ft long with a rust-red stripe roll gently as it passed over at about 300ft in June 2019.

31.place: A61 between Ripon and the A1, towards RAF Leeming
31.summary: An RAF engineer and friends driving back from Ripon saw an orange ball rise from a field and leap towards their car, pacing them before vanishing; the memory resurfaced decades later in matching dreams.

32.place: Field by Swinemoor School via Fotherby Walk, Bridlington
32.summary: Around 1988 a man saw a huge ginger cat-like animal walk behind a slim tree and fail to reappear; his companion saw nothing.

33.place: Edge of Gainsborough, towards Foxby Hill
33.summary: While watching Starlink satellites, a couple saw a small fuzzy triangle of four or five lights revolving around each other cross silently overhead in about 15 seconds.

34.summary: Three fixed orange lights flew slowly and silently over a house, were met by a red flashing light, and moved off together in a triangle.

35.summary: A commuter driving from Flamborough to Speeton saw a big black cat drinking at Buckton pond; it looked at her and slipped into the hedge.

36.summary: A walker at Bempton on a dull afternoon saw an extremely bright star-shaped flash burst out of the clouds, unlike lightning.

37.summary: Boys playing out around 1981 saw a stationary row of slowly rotating white lights under the cloud base for about a minute; it was gone when they looked again.

38.summary: A couple saw a large blue neon boomerang-shaped object two weeks running, once circled by an orange orb, and later a silent black triangle with three white corner lights glide over the trees.

39.place: Over the LUK factory, Wales Bar, seen from the Aston–Kiveton road
39.summary: Driving to work around 1992 a miner saw a stationary white-yellow ball of light hanging over an industrial estate, which shot straight up and vanished.

40.place: Beside the River Trent, near RAF Scampton area
40.summary: A mother and child saw a fighter-sized black dot hover motionless a few hundred metres up, then dart sideways at a speed unlike any local military jet.

41.summary: One correspondent recounts a mercury-like orb over Aberdeen followed by shadow figures and poltergeist activity, a red blob beside his daughter's kite in Hemingbrough, a farmhouse apparition, and a blinding flash near Eggborough power station.

42.summary: A hotelier helping clean rooms saw a solid-looking elderly woman in old-fashioned clothes walk into bedroom 1, which was then empty; his wife had seen her twice before.

44.summary: A couple leaving friends' house saw a glass-bright light for five seconds; the husband later said it was pyramid-shaped.

45.summary: During a December 2020 flap, a Leeds photographer captured a sequence of orange lights over the sea off North Landing; Paul saw splitting orange lights from Bempton the next night and a white light was reported near Sandsend.

46.summary: A night taxi driver saw a jet-black Labrador-sized cat with a long thick tail bound across the road in front of him.

47.place: Hedon to Burstwick road near the Weghill Road turn
47.summary: A driver saw three solid red lights switch on in a triangle and fly in formation south towards the Humber; a deep boom had been felt on the farm a couple of nights earlier.

48.summary: A retired police officer and her retired-pilot husband watched a red and a white light move slowly and silently over rooftops, then disappear behind a sycamore.

49.summary: Paul and two friends filmed golden spheres behind cloud with a night-vision camera, invisible to the naked eye, binoculars and thermal scope.

50.summary: Driving to her horses, a woman saw a glowing orange globe jump between positions, then three in a row turn together and vanish over the sea.

51.place: Langtoft–Sledmere road at the Butterwick crossroads
51.summary: Paul and Steve Ashbridge repeatedly saw pale white and red lights drift through the roadside hawthorn hedge without lighting anything, vanishing when approached, during their Wolds skywatches.

52.summary: A new resident woke to an elderly stooped man with a stick telling her it was his house; he apologised and vanished, and she later recognised him in an old village photo.

53.place: North Landing and the Yorkshire coast
53.summary: A compilation of sea anglers' accounts of rows of orange lights strobing offshore from Runswick to Aldbrough, including a North Landing report that led to a lifeboat and Sea King search finding nothing.

54.place: B1253 Sledmere to Bridlington road near Sledmere
54.summary: Paul and a sceptical workmate watched a huge long white pulsing object hang over a field in afternoon daylight for five minutes before vanishing; a couple reported a silver disc on the same road in 1990.

55.summary: An aircraft enthusiast saw three high, fast objects in a perfect triangle with no contrails go behind a cloud and not emerge.

56.place: Ings Road estate, East Hull (object over Bilton/Sproatley)
56.summary: Prompted by an inner voice, a man watched a polished silver cylinder move slowly and silently across the sky for 15 minutes in summer 2001.

57.summary: At lunchtime a man saw a smooth white triangle jerk and spin above a jet, which seemed to swerve, before it headed down the coast.

58.place: Over the sea between Filey and Speeton
58.summary: A couple driving at night saw a large orange ring-shaped light just offshore, later appearing as a line of orange light; a phone photo was taken.

59.summary: Four soldiers driving at 2am were overtaken by a huge spinning silver disc ringed with white lights, passing silently about 200ft above.

60.summary: A Bempton couple watched four low military jets manoeuvre around a glowing green orb in the evening sky.

61.place: Driffield Road / old Nafferton Slacks Road junction, Nafferton
61.summary: A driver saw a sparkling red ball descend to hover above a searching helicopter, then shoot off towards Bridlington.

62.summary: At dawn a resident watched a dark cloud over the sea break up and reform into three solid pyramid shapes lined up on the horizon, and hid in fear.

63.summary: On honeymoon, a man outside a village pub saw a silent red light pass over that seemed to reveal a cloaked outline, heading towards Kendal.

64.summary: Paul and a friend in misty conditions saw the whole cove, sea and cliffs, flooded with white light from no visible source for about ten seconds, twice.

65.summary: A man had an out-of-body experience in a hotel room and saw three entities, one mummy-like, approach his sleeping girlfriend until he cried out and woke.

66.summary: A couple on a walk watched a small solid black ball fly in a straight line at constant height among birds; no wings or propellers were visible.

67.place: Road between Driffield and Hutton Cranswick, towards Southburn
67.summary: A driver saw a massive red disc with two spinning green wheel-like discs fly low over busy traffic towards Southburn.

68.place: A438 between Sledge Green and Rye Street
68.summary: Hitchhiking at 3–4am, a man saw a very bright white light charge up above the clouds and streak off westward leaving a short tail.

70.place: Weaverthorpe and Butt Lane near Wold Newton
70.summary: A couple near Weaverthorpe saw two huge orange spheres over the Wolds, then many dull red spheres flying erratically near Octon, and the same lights repeatedly following a route over their home.

71.place: Bempton cliffs near the old RAF buildings
71.summary: A lone night walker and friends in a car saw two white lights swaying side to side near the RAF bunkers for 10–15 minutes, retreating when approached.

72.summary: A child in 1968 saw a comet-like white ball with a green tint fall from the sky and apparently hit the ground with red sparks but no sound.

73.summary: An angler saw five orange lights blink on and off over the horizon off Aldbrough around 2000, and in 2019 orange orbs glowing in clouds off Scarborough, followed by two jets.

74.place: Road approaching New Earswick, north of York
74.summary: A woman driving from Haxby saw a blue glowing orb drop onto her car's front corner; everything was oddly silent, the trip took about an hour instead of 15 minutes, and the indicator was found smashed and coated in strange fluid.

75.summary: Boys from a children's home on a night walk saw a silent, lightless black mass fill the sky above them; staff hurried them back to the minibus.

76.summary: A resident photographed and filmed two bright blue circles moving low, silently and in a straight line behind cloud over his house at 12.30am.

77.summary: While reeling in his daughter's kite, a man saw a red amorphous blob materialise beside it for a few seconds and fade away.

78.summary: Paul saw orange spheres flash on and off over the sea off South Landing and towards Speeton; the same night a driver near Langtoft and another observer reported similar lights.

79.place: Iron bench on the Findhorn gorge path, Glenferness estate
79.summary: A couple sitting on a bench by a cliff face felt and saw a hairy, ape-like hand dart out of solid rock and grab the woman's hip before vanishing.

80.place: Moorland ridge above Buckstones Road, Shaw
80.summary: A dog walker saw a silent red flashing light race along the moor ridge and disappear abruptly after ten seconds.

81.summary: From her bedroom a woman watched a small black rugby-ball shaped object tumble, pause, change shape and fly off west in daylight.

82.summary: The same witness saw a translucent grey orb exit and pass through walls in her bedroom, found an unexplained painless puncture wound, and shares photos showing faces at York and Bodmin pubs.

83.summary: A skywatcher saw an intense white flash followed by a white ball shooting east into cloud.

84.place: Humber foreshore beneath the Humber Bridge, Hessle
84.summary: A diver receiving decompression treatment saw a big cat 50m away on the riverbank; they stared at each other before it slipped into the woods.

85.summary: A man on the Esplanade saw two identical sweeping orange flashes far out to sea, then a silent white-yellow light that went out as he watched.

86.summary: Paul filmed several silent moving lights over Bempton; review of the footage showed six objects, more than were seen by eye.

87.summary: Paul and Bob Brown filmed a slow white light that turned out to be accompanied by other spheres moving in different directions.

88.place: Moor-top car park on the A169 above Sleights, near RAF Fylingdales
88.summary: A visitor photographed a slowly moving bright object over the moors near Fylingdales in afternoon daylight.

89.summary: A driver followed a fast bright white ball for nearly a minute until it dimmed to a dark ball and was lost over the moors towards Denshaw.

90.place: Country lane near Borough Green, Kent
90.summary: A mother and daughter saw a cricket-ball-sized white light pace their car at the driver's window before veering over the hedge.

91.summary: Driving at dawn, a greenkeeper saw a pair of glowing yellow eyes about a metre off the ground and widely spaced cross the road, with no visible body.

92.summary: A driver braked for a cougar-sized black cat with a long tail that crossed the road; dashcam caught only a black blur.

93.summary: A couple walking the beach photographed bright orange balls appearing one after another before fading after two minutes.

94.summary: Paul filmed a light that burst into view over the sea and vanished silently, shortly after another further down the coast.

95.summary: A family group visiting Fort Paull heard and saw pebbles strike a wall and one of them with no thrower present; their car later filled with an ancient musty smell.

96.summary: A dog walker saw a black leopard-like cat stalking a hedge 30m away; separately she heard an unearthly metallic screeching in woods near Danby.

97.place: Old Hull–Barnsley railway path off Calvert Lane, Hull
97.summary: Two colleagues watched a star-like point zigzag around Vega before shooting off; the same man later saw odd flashing lights near Vega from Wetwang.

98.summary: An early-morning observer photographed a shiny silver object moving faster than an airliner and silently.

99.summary: A sceptical mother woke to a small naked green being with kind eyes at her bedside that seemed to try to communicate, then floated out through the window.

100.summary: A farmer photographed a solid tube of white light rising 60–100ft from a harvested field that then sank back into the ground; thermal scanning found nothing.

101.place: Bempton cliffs, looking towards Staple Newk
101.summary: Three men including a serving soldier watched an orange-red sphere sit on the cliff for up to 20 minutes, then jump hundreds of yards in seconds and hover over the path.

102.summary: A witness saw at least three intensely orange glowing orbs move erratically and fade in and out silently for about five minutes.

103.place: Filey cliffs/country park, seen from Danes Dyke clifftop
103.summary: A morning walker at Danes Dyke photographed a stationary strong light apparently on or over Filey cliffs in misty weather.

104.summary: Two people saw a still oval of green and red lights that moved, dropped straight down and swept away, dwarfing a plane; a relative had odd time distortion near Blackstone Edge.

105.summary: A resident saw a bright green oval zigzag through clouds and stop beside the neighbour's roof, flying off silently when he opened the window.

106.summary: A witness saw giant linked green neon rings followed by a military jet at about 1,000ft.

107.summary: A couple watching the ISS saw repeated very bright flashes in a different part of the sky and filmed one.

109.summary: Drivers in a traffic queue on the A1 watched a dull metallic disc as wide as a football pitch with coloured lights drift low across the road; the same witness also saw a large light release and recall two small lights over the Calder Valley.

110.summary: A supporter's handwritten report (image only on the page) describes a flying rotating wheel of foliage near Bempton Chalet Park.

111.place: Campsite at Eastnor Castle deer park
111.summary: A couple at a festival watched a small self-lit orb wander into their tent and trace figure-eights over the stove; afterwards nearly two hours had passed unnoticed.

112.summary: During a storm a man saw a black shadow form enter the tent towards the children, and his partner saw a mist over them; he reportedly went out for an hour with no memory of it.

113.summary: A driver saw a wingless silver-grey object, bulbous at the front, move slowly towards old RAF Driffield; bird flocks behaved oddly afterwards.

114.summary: A dog walker saw a solid orange object move steadily across the sky for a minute or two before blinking out.

115.summary: A nine-year-old boy in 1970 saw the shadow of a man with a dog's head cross the curtained window; nobody was found outside.

116.place: A614 near Middleton on the Wolds
116.summary: A family driving at night watched a star-like light dart, stop dead, climb vertically and hover far more nimbly than an aircraft.

117.summary: A woman watched a matte black, flat-looking oval tumble slowly westward over houses in clear daylight.

118.summary: Two night-shift workers saw a very large black cat with a long tail glide across a road inside the secure industrial site.

119.place: Fields between Middleton on the Wolds and Wetwang
119.summary: A bright, slow ball of light made a gentle half-circle turn near Wetwang's southern edge before disappearing into cloud.

120.place: Quarry Lane roundabout, A174 between Marske and Saltburn
120.summary: After a night shift, a driver found himself stopped watching two golden orbs move in tandem overhead in a muffled silence, then reached home about 40 minutes later than he should have.

121.summary: A witness saw nine star-like lights crossing east to west, four holding formation while the others swapped positions at speed.

122.summary: A walker saw an oval object with a silver centre and white rim dive down and fly fast along a hedgerow into a field.

123.summary: A walker saw a black cigar-shaped silhouette move slowly north in the south-east sky; it was gone when he looked back.

124.summary: Two plasterers saw a grey coffee-bean shaped object drop through a cloud, rotate, then race off horizontally towards Cleethorpes.

125.summary: A pre-dawn driver saw three stationary orange spheres stacked vertically beside a farm's lights.

126.place: Garden near Weaverthorpe, looking towards Foxholes
126.summary: A couple saw a sun-like sphere apparently generating a small cloud climb rapidly, leaving a spiral trail, and photographed it.

127.summary: A skywatcher saw two blue star-like points pass overhead together, then a flashing blue one on the same track, followed by a low helicopter.

128.summary: Paul photographed a Bempton power pole whose top had burned from within and fallen without breaking the wires, on a clear day with no lightning.

129.place: A170 west of Pickering near the Marton/Sinnington crossroads
129.summary: A van driver saw three yellow lights slowly change formation from triangle to line over eight minutes.

130.place: Stock Dale Farm, Daisy Hill Road, Burton Pidsea
130.summary: A cyclist photographed a fast white light above a farmhouse before it shot off to the left.

131.summary: Paul and a colleague filmed light forms appearing at random over the sea across several nights; a Hornsea couple saw the lights and a cigar shape.

132.place: B1253 Sledmere to Bridlington road near Sledmere
132.summary: Paul's own account of a huge white pulsing object hanging silently over a field in daylight with a workmate in 2003.

133.place: B1253 Sledmere to Bridlington road near Sledmere
133.summary: A Goole couple stopped to watch a large silent silver disc hover over trees by the road in 1990; it vanished as if a curtain closed.

134.place: Bridlington, Scarborough Road area towards Grindale
134.summary: Four witnesses in two households saw large silent glowing white balls of light hang and then move off over Bridlington after midnight.

135.summary: Seven people at a barbecue saw a large orange-red glowing object glide against the wind twice, sinking out of sight behind a house the second time.

136.place: Wansford Road and River Head, Driffield
136.summary: Barbecue guests saw a red-glowing sphere with a central bright spot pass over twice; days earlier a couple saw a huge burning-red sphere at River Head shoot up into cloud.

137.place: Off Flamborough Head lighthouse, seen from Bridlington seafront
137.summary: A dawn dog walker saw a bright red ball hover below the clouds right of the lighthouse for 10–15 minutes.

138.summary: Paul's notes on lights he filmed on the Wolds: preceded by small flashes, fading when cars approach, and followed by military helicopters including a Chinook.

139.summary: At a bus stop a man and a stranger saw a cluster of star-like lights drift into a circle, with one shooting north in an instant.

140.place: Hillside by the B8024 at Ormsary, Argyll
140.summary: A family saw a pure white triangle move jerkily over a hilltop and glide down and back up the slope without turning.

142.summary: A van driver saw a silent orange ball cross the sky and dim out within seconds.

143.place: Back gardens in Lewisham, south-east London
143.summary: A child saw three lights joined by a huge pitch-black triangle hover over gardens, creep forward and vanish with a crack.

145.summary: A resident saw randomly flashing blue-white pinpoints crossing slowly, then a tight cluster of steady warm lights on the same track.

147.summary: A man leaving a neighbour's at midnight photographed a large bright white orb moving north that dispersed into a round cloud-like shape.

148.summary: An angler photographed two dark disc-like objects in the Manchester flight path; one faded and the other climbed into cloud.

149.summary: A late-night observer saw a white light fade in and out, flash, and zip sideways at an angle before vanishing.

150.summary: Six skywatchers with military backgrounds saw a star-like cream object over the sea off Flamborough wriggle like a tadpole, lurch forward twice, and turn inland.

151.place: Flag Hill fishing lakes, Great Bentley, Essex
151.summary: Around 5am three teenage friends leaving a night-fishing lake saw a brushed-metal silver sphere hovering a few metres above a cow field. After about ten seconds it shot straight upward and vanished.

152.place: Under the Birmingham Airport flight path (home facing south-east)
152.summary: A couple woke at 2:50am to see a large white light in the east that turned red and triangular, appeared to chase a smaller light, changed to green and climbed, then flashed and faded out.

153.summary: In 1969 a girl playing with friends saw a high light swoop down and stop over them, becoming a swirling red light; her father also saw it and both felt it was observing them.

154.place: Far Grange holiday park near Skirlington, Skipsea
154.summary: A man stargazing on a sun lounger saw five lights in a trapezoid form, apparently one object about 30ft long, pass silently about 100ft overhead towards the golf course and out to sea; his dog panicked beforehand and trees swished after it passed.

155.summary: A Hull man saw a cluster of silvery balls drift high to the east one week, and a week later a stationary brass-coloured object shaped like an ice lolly, which he watched through binoculars until cloud hid it.

157.place: Cliffs by Blue Dolphin holiday park, Gristhorpe near Filey
157.summary: Walking back from Cayton Bay at dusk, a holidaymaker saw several flashing lights first by the beach and then hanging in the air over the foggy sea, distinct from a nearby ship.

158.place: Blackheath overlooking Greenwich Park and Canary Wharf, London
158.summary: A tradesman photographing the view from Blackheath in December 2018 later found a bright white door-like rectangle in the sky in one of his pictures that he had not noticed at the time.

159.place: Back garden on Birmingham Airport flight path, West Midlands
159.summary: Using binoculars, a man, his son and his wife watched a stationary metallic ball for nearly an hour; the man then saw it slowly rotate to reveal a cigar or cylinder shape before it was lost.

160.summary: A Wetwang skywatcher saw three black silent L-shaped objects fly south in the afternoon, then that night watched dozens of faint blue and orange lights stream past Vega through binoculars for over an hour.

161.place: Motorcycle rally camping field between York and Selby
161.summary: At a rally bonfire around 2am a man watched a pair of orange satellite-like lights cross the sky and then stop dead overhead as a genuine satellite passed them; they stayed fixed for around fifteen minutes before vanishing.

162.summary: From his window a man saw a large hazy orange oval which split into two orange orbs that moved apart with a bouncing motion over about five minutes.

163.place: Lyth Hill near Bayston Hill, south of Shrewsbury
163.summary: Two dog walkers on Lyth Hill saw a bright stationary orange light appear over Wenlock Edge, hold for about thirty seconds and then dim away as if on a dimmer switch.

164.summary: Leaving the Spa Pavilion one evening, members of a group repeatedly glimpsed an orange orb over the sea which kept switching off before others could see it. An added note describes two orange lights over Bridlington Priory that sped off and vanished.

165.place: View from Norton Canes High School towards Heath Hayes, Staffordshire
165.summary: In 1982/83 a pupil gazing out of a classroom window saw a large flat orange ball cross between two spoil heaps, appearing to bounce in mid-air.

166.place: M6 Junction 11 slip road, near Cannock
166.summary: Two women leaving the M6 in summer 1989 saw a round, shiny metallic object high up that turned on edge and disappeared; the local paper reported a wok-like UFO nearby that week.

167.summary: A man letting his dog out filmed a very bright silent object that swirled, pulsed and changed length while slowly receding and fading; silent lightning and a green flash followed.

168.place: Bempton village looking towards the cliffs
168.summary: At 2:30am a lone photographer in Bempton shot a purplish-pink light that blinked in and out with a pink cloud-like effect around it, later spotting a second small light in the frame.

169.place: A165 just past the Fraisthorpe turn-off
169.summary: Driving home from Bridlington, a man saw a hooded girl with two small children by the road; the girl dashed across in front of the car ahead and vanished into a solid hedge, the children were gone, and neither his wife nor the other driver reacted.

170.summary: At about 2:20am a man looking out of his back door saw a silent triangle with softly glowing lights at each corner glide away within a few seconds.

171.place: Countryside near Fimber, heading towards Sledmere
171.summary: A rural resident saw a slow bright yellow light trailed by a pale blue one moving west to east from Fimber towards Sledmere; both faded out within seconds, silently.

172.place: Moors near Winter Hill, north of Bolton, Lancashire
172.summary: A family account: parents driving over the moors north of Bolton in the 1970s saw a shiny spinning disc hover then race off, and years later a brother saw a glowing blue-purple rectangle in the same area; other family ghost experiences are also mentioned.

173.summary: In 1967 a group of boys on a skywatch saw a steady silent light, resolved by binoculars into three lights forming a stubby cigar, which rose sharply away; two of them saw a smaller light drop from it.

174.summary: Around 1964 a boy and four friends saw a fast silent white light stop, then two red lights approached from either side and merged with it before it sped off.

175.place: B1248 near Fimber roundabout, by the bikers' cafe and Yorkshire Wolds Railway
175.summary: A woman driving home at dusk saw a jet-black animal shaped like a small bear but with a long tail bound across the road from the bikers' cafe and into a hedge gap.

176.summary: A driver saw two very bright white lights circling each other high in the eastern sky, apparently over the sea off Skipsea, before they separated north and south; no aircraft showed on tracking apps.

177.summary: As a teenager the witness dreamt of floating over a nearby roundabout watching a red orb, then woke on the bedroom floor despite sleeping in a railed top bunk.

178.place: Chapel Lane, Upper Halling, near Rochester, Kent
178.summary: A rural postman in about 1998 watched a large black cat, at first mistaken for a cow because of its size, saunter across a field towards the tree line.

179.summary: Paul Sinclair and two friends watched an orange glow on the hill behind the cliffs, then saw a huge orange sphere rise and drop; a second sphere was caught on Sionyx camera.

180.place: Fields off Wike Ridge Lane near Shadwell, north-east Leeds
180.summary: From a works van a man saw a large jet-black four-legged animal, part wolf and part cat with pointed ears and a bushy tail, walking smoothly across an open field about 300m away.

181.place: Balcony flat in Redcar (earlier missing time near Strensall, York)
181.summary: From his fourth-floor balcony a man filmed a light that halted overhead and made erratic movements in 2020, and again in 2021; he also recounts losing about 90 minutes after driving through a fog bank on a lane near Strensall in 1999.

182.place: Bempton Cliffs, looking north-east over the sea
182.summary: Paul Sinclair filmed three bright star-like lights moving away silently over the sea as if one huge triangular object; a contact separately saw a similar formation from the A69 the next morning.

183.summary: While trying to photograph the aurora a mother saw a sudden chain of very bright orange lights flare far out over the sea and captured them in long-exposure photos.

184.place: Junction of Grindale Lane, Bridlington, looking over the Priory
184.summary: A driver pulling out of Grindale Lane saw three white cigar-shaped craft with possible portholes hanging over the Priory area; they were gone after a glance in his mirror.

185.place: Road from Bamburgh to Seahouses, Northumberland
185.summary: A driver saw a steady warm-yellow light descend slowly in the sky above the hills, then shrink and wink out; he acknowledges a flare from RAF Boulmer is possible.

186.place: Childhood home in Darfield near Barnsley
186.summary: A retired police officer recalls shadowy featureless figures floating out of his bedroom wall as a small child; his parents later revealed a large white owl had repeatedly sat at his window. He goes on to describe later UFO experiences.

187.summary: A compilation of six Penistone ghost tales, led by the Paramount Cinema where a phantom elderly caretaker and his dog are said to have been seen many times.

188.place: Wooded lane south of Sherburn towards Weaverthorpe, Yorkshire Wolds
188.summary: Driving home at night in 1989, a 17-year-old was followed by a white light along the lanes from Sherburn towards Weaverthorpe; he also passes on other local strange-experience leads.

189.place: Church Lane by Brodsworth Hall, between Marr and Pickburn
189.summary: In about 1987 a boy and his grandfather saw a small neon-pink oval hover over Pickburn for a few seconds before darting off.

190.place: Driffield, on the road from Bridlington
190.summary: Two men commuting at dawn saw bright orange spheres appear and vanish in turn; one appeared to pace their car and was filmed before shrinking to a pinprick.

191.place: Lockwood Cemetery and Beaumont Park, Huddersfield
191.summary: Walking his dog on an overcast evening, a man watched a bright orange-red fireball-like light move slowly through low cloud overhead and veer away south; he believes he saw the same object the next morning heading the other way, and adds later sightings.

192.summary: A lone night photographer at 4:15am saw a silent spinning saucer with an orange centre and flickering white rim sweep low over his head, curve around just outside his camera's field of view and dart off over the sea.

193.place: Filey Bay beach looking towards the Speeton cliffs
193.summary: Walking the beach at sunset, a visitor saw a red-orange light drop down the cliff face to hover over the sea, turn white and vanish; it returned and slowly divided into two lights. He took video and photos.

194.place: Old mine-shaft field below Blackstone Edge, Littleborough
194.summary: Around 2005 two children playing at dusk saw a large lean dog-like silhouette with upright ears and big glowing deep-red eyes staring at them from about 30 yards; they fled in terror.

195.place: Kensington Gardens and other west London landmarks
195.summary: Filming the sky at several London tourist spots in August 2015, a man later found a fast dark object crossing the frame and a hovering object that seemed to change shape in his clips.

196.place: Beach car park at Sandsend near Whitby
196.summary: Stepping out of her campervan at 6am, a woman came face to face with a large thick-set tawny cat with tufted ears standing on an upturned boat behind the car park; she is sure it was a lynx.

197.place: First-floor flat at Rednal, foot of the Lickey Hills, Birmingham
197.summary: A man watched three large orange orbs hang still before merging and fading; a month later a glowing blue-purple rugby-ball shaped object with pulsing vein-like patterns hovered only metres from his window.

198.place: Old house flat overlooking a park near Preston city centre
198.summary: Sleeping on a friend's living-room floor in the early 1980s, a man was woken before dawn by loud rhythmic taps on the balcony window, twice, though the balcony was unreachable and empty.

199.place: A6033 between Oxenhope and Pecket Well
199.summary: Driving over the tops one November evening in 1994, a man was chased by two close-set low white lights that caught up, appeared to pass right through or over his car, and vanished beyond the next rise.

200.place: Danes Dyke near Bempton (from Wold Farm campsite)
200.summary: A camper photographed lights moving at walking pace along Danes Dyke for over half an hour one August evening in 2019, watching until they went out.

201.place: West Hull, behind the witness's home
201.summary: An elderly woman heard a loud low drone and saw a large glittering gold light with tiny stub wings hover between houses behind her garden before shooting off east.

202.place: B1248 between Wharram le Street and the Towthorpe turn, looking towards York
202.summary: Driving home after midnight, a man photographed and filmed two gold lights drifting low over the western horizon towards Strensall; in January 2024 he saw a twinkling gold sphere hanging over York that vanished as he stopped.

203.summary: A Cardiff man filmed a bright silent object with what looked like four lights beneath moving east from the St Athan direction; earlier he had seen a flat disc with circling lights followed by military helicopters.

204.summary: Paul Sinclair and two friends watched a large white sphere of light drift slowly low in the sky near the old RAF base, which he filmed for nearly three minutes before it vanished.

205.place: Gated lane near Ewden village, by Wharncliffe Crags
205.summary: In about 1990 a couple walking in bright midday sun saw a tall, grey, smoke-like figure stride across the lane ahead and dissolve into the trees; the man felt strangely unable to speak during it.

206.summary: A woman walking her dog at dusk saw a pale humanoid creature cross the trail ahead on all fours, matching descriptions of the so-called Rake.

207.place: Northern edge of Norley Wood near East End, New Forest
207.summary: A wildlife watcher startled a tawny, chunky cat the size of a roe deer with big paws and a short thick tail, which bounded into scrub; he believes it was a lynx.

210.place: College Hill House beside Rosslyn Chapel, Roslin
210.summary: On a family holiday, Paul Sinclair saw a fast light on the chapel wall; at the rented house his daughter heard singing, his wife saw a shadow on the landing and family members saw small lights moving in the lounge.

211.place: A169 by the Hole of Horcum, near RAF Fylingdales
211.summary: A second-hand account of an MOD police officer on night patrol who saw a big leopard-like black cat cross the road in his headlights; returning with his sergeant they found large claw gouges on a lay-by bin.

212.summary: An experienced skywatcher saw three dim blue points in a fixed triangle glide north to south past Vega for about six seconds, silently, before disappearing.

213.summary: Paul Sinclair filmed lights apparently beneath the sea surface moving steadily out from the cliffs for over four minutes on a low-light camera.

214.place: Cliff path between Bempton and Speeton
214.summary: A visitor walking the misty clifftop path took around 75 minutes to reach Speeton but only about 20 minutes to get back, feeling as if he had been transported.

215.place: Field by Danes Dyke near the old RAF Bempton site
215.summary: While talking with Paul Sinclair, a man saw a strange flat, almost two-dimensional object glide across a field and vanish where the coast path dips, apparently into the ground; Paul turned too late to see it.

216.place: Back garden in Letchworth, North Hertfordshire
216.summary: Over two evenings a woman watched several faint white lights cross the sky slowly one at a time, curve and wink out; her tracking app showed no satellites overhead.

217.place: Back door of a house in Weaverthorpe, Yorkshire Wolds
217.summary: A man saw a silent orange ring, bigger than the moon, rise vertically into cloud with a wavy line rotating across it; he also describes feeling watched in his paddock at night.

218.place: Southfield Well Balk, between The Spinney and the sewage works, Wetwang
218.summary: Walking his dog, a man saw a slow vase-shaped tube of light lying on its side with gold lights at each end and a transparent middle move north to south before dimming away.

219.place: Woldgate, countryside on the edge of Bridlington
219.summary: On an evening drive, Paul Sinclair and his friend Bob saw one light and then two in the sky over Woldgate and both photographed them, without any explanation.

220.summary: A woman recalls seeing a silver disc through a skylight with her father in 1976 before it shot upwards; her father, a regular Cley Hill skywatcher, came home once with an unexplained healed burn, and she later lost an hour during a sighting.

221.place: Fields between Bierley Woods and Bierley Lane, south Bradford
221.summary: In 1997 a man and his father walking the dog saw a dark silent triangle with white tip lights pass low overhead and descend towards Bradford city centre; further sightings followed.

222.summary: In November 1977 three women getting off a bus saw a dark silent shape with reversed red and green lights and a huge flashing white light pass low over the factory; a colleague saw it near Bailiff Bridge.

223.place: Field beside the road just south of the Ivychurch junction, Romney Marsh
223.summary: A driver saw a brilliant white tic-tac shaped object streak in from the sea and drop behind roadside trees, then glimpsed a grey craft with black markings hovering about 50ft above a field before it shot back out to sea.

224.place: Rendlesham Forest trail near Capel Green and the UFO model
224.summary: A regular visitor found two deer heads lying apart with no bodies or blood near the forest's UFO model, then felt an overwhelming fear of being followed all the way back to the car.

225.place: Rutland Street, Filey (also Filey Country Park facing the Brigg)
225.summary: A Filey teenager describes triangular craft over a play park, an orange orb zig-zagging seaward trailing sparks and apparently pursued by jets amid sudden silence, and later seven lights in formation off Filey Brigg.

226.place: Neighbour's roof and cherry tree, Whitehaven, Cumbria
226.summary: Waking suddenly as a teenager, a man saw a huge silver-blue dog-headed creature crouched on a neighbour's roof which climbed down a tree and loomed at his window with glowing red eyes; he woke later unsure if it was a dream.

227.place: Southfield Well Balk, Wetwang, looking east over the sea
227.summary: A skywatcher on a dark lane saw a gold ball overhead, two gold sparking streaks low in the east and then lights flicking on and off far out over the North Sea, which Paul Sinclair also witnessed.

228.place: North Morte Farm campsite, Mortehoe, Devon
228.summary: A couple at breakfast outside their campervan watched one or two bright silver triangles shining high over the sea through binoculars for some time.

229.place: Eston, Middlesbrough, looking over the Tees towards Teesport
229.summary: A taxi driver and his passenger saw three silent round objects each with a steady red glow follow the River Tees out to sea before splitting up over Teesport.

230.place: East side of Lakeside lake by the Travelodge, Doncaster
230.summary: A regular walker saw three silent orange balls in a triangle drift south over the lake, each outer light darting away and back to the formation in turn.

231.place: B1248 heading south from Wharram le Street
231.summary: Driving home, a man saw a very bright steady blue-white sphere race east to west beneath the cloud base for about five seconds.

232.summary: A Hull man photographed and filmed an elongated steady light crossing west to east, checking that neither space station was overhead.

233.place: Portree harbour, Isle of Skye (with a second report from Dundee)
233.summary: An aurora photographer saw a bright orange light flare up and move slowly north before vanishing; a separate Dundee report describes a green flashing light that repeatedly stopped dead, rotated and sped off.

234.summary: A skywatcher saw a black object of three round sections in a triangle move against the wind and disappear in the seconds he took to clean his binoculars.

235.place: Fields beside the A170 on the way to Scarborough
235.summary: Driving at about 3:30am in 2007, a parent saw a huge oval light sweeping back and forth inside a cloud above fields; a milk-delivery woman she stopped to talk to had seen it too.

236.summary: Working at night, a woman saw the transparent outline of a man in a work jacket, baggy trousers and cap stroll into her lounge and vanish after three steps.

239.summary: Paul Sinclair shares footage of glowing light beneath the sea filmed from the cliffs, a kind of luminosity he says is regularly seen on this coast.

240.place: B1253 at the Octon roundabout, looking west towards York
240.summary: Driving home late, a man saw a bright golden light low over the horizon apparently above York, under cloud cover.

241.summary: Paul Sinclair and friends filmed a striking ten-minute display of lights in the sky from the cliffs, which he presents as a spectacle of the natural sky rather than a typical anomaly.

242.summary: A holiday photo from Scarborough shows a silvery sphere sitting on the sea; Paul and Don suggest a fishing buoy or a stray beach ball as possible explanations.

243.summary: Cutting hedges on a clear day, a man saw a silent chrome hourglass-shaped object of two joined teardrops pass quickly overhead from the Menwith Hill direction and photographed it as it left.

244.summary: A witness photographed a silent, wingless jet-black object moving west to east before it went into cloud; enlarging the image showed an apparent haze around it.

245.summary: Paul Sinclair and friends filmed unexplained lights from the cliffs which looked yellow to the eye but registered differently on camera.

246.summary: At lunchtime a man saw two identical wingless metallic objects glinting in the sun as they moved slowly together across the sky.

247.place: Paddock and field behind a house in the East Riding
247.summary: Out with his dog near midnight, a man saw a squat self-luminous silver-grey figure about 5ft tall drift across the next field; walking towards the spot brought on overwhelming fear that lifted when he turned back.

248.place: Outside a care home in Sutton-in-Craven near Keighley
248.summary: A care worker filmed silent lights performing stop-start dancing movements in the sky for about six minutes at around 3am.

249.summary: Ian Linford, filming with Paul Sinclair, captured an object invisible to the naked eye that shifts shape within itself frame by frame, nicknamed 'the 25'.

250.place: Field path between Greasbrough and Parkgate, north Rotherham
250.summary: Walking his dog, a man photographed a black object moving with a juddery yet effortless glide that looped and climbed into cloud; he half suspects a hang glider.

251.place: Back of a fast-food shop in Whitehaven
251.summary: Three workers on a cigarette break saw a marble-like ball of light bobbing up and down in the sky, photographed and briefly filmed it, before it disappeared.

252.summary: A man found a small dark disc-like shape in the second of two photos of the city view taken seconds apart, absent from the first.

253.place: Broadgate near Monks Road, below Lincoln Cathedral
253.summary: A community nurse stuck at traffic lights watched a white oblong craft, a little smaller than a bus, cross slowly above the cathedral from east to west.

254.place: Industrial site at Rawcliffe Bridge, north of Crowle Moors
254.summary: Night-shift workers in a fenced smoking area repeatedly felt watched and heard heavy movement and two distinct footsteps in the treeline by the railway, which the witness believes was a dogman.

255.place: Garden on the outskirts of Chesterfield
255.summary: Through powerful binoculars a man watched a white ball with a gold light circling it travel along an aircraft contrail, then a second shape-shifting object follow the same path, which he photographed over about 35 minutes.

256.summary: A nurse's journal: in 1989 she drove beneath a stationary glowing cloud spitting fire and sparks near Soham that was gone when she arrived home; she also describes an unseen thing in Sandringham woods and later apparitions.

257.place: Track to a poultry farm just west of Kilnwick, East Yorkshire
257.summary: A farm worker looking down a stone track saw a long, athletic black cat like a puma with a long curled tail.

258.place: Cobden Close, Hednesford, on the edge of Cannock Chase
258.summary: Two children saw a 6 to 7ft black hooded figure with glowing red eyes by the fridge; in the bedroom where they hid the locked door unlocked, the air turned cold and the figure stood over them before rising to the loft.

259.place: Hill Farm onshore oil site between Winchester and Stockbridge
259.summary: A lone night-shift oil worker saw a faceless figure, black below and red above, run across the lit site and vanish mid-leap; police called afterwards found nothing.

260.place: Over the English Channel, seen from an airliner
260.summary: A passenger flying from Istanbul watched a small cigar-shaped object drift very slowly for about fifteen minutes while private jets passed it quickly.

261.place: Box bedroom of a house in Sleaford, Lincolnshire
261.summary: A man woke on his back to a solid jet-black cloaked figure floating just above him; he rolled out and felt it pressing after him as he reached the light switch, where it vanished.

262.summary: A man on restricted army ground photographed a distant brown upright figure which he believes was a bigfoot.

263.summary: Watching two satellite-like lights cross east, a woman saw the white one turn sharply north and race away leaving a brief trail.

264.summary: A man saw and filmed a silent row of six lights alternating green and red that rose and drifted slowly away south.

266.place: B1253 just past the Octon roundabout, looking towards Stamford Bridge
266.summary: Driving home late, a man saw a bright vertical elliptical light appear high in the sky towards Stamford Bridge and fade out within seconds.

267.place: Retreat centre in County Wexford, Ireland
267.summary: Stargazing from a window, a woman filmed flashing lights over the sea which repeatedly blinked out abruptly, unlike aircraft.

268.place: Fields beside the railway just south of Knebworth
268.summary: From an early train a commuter saw a large black cat-like animal running up a field towards woods; a big cat sanctuary was later found to lie beyond those woods.

269.summary: A man seeking connection with nature in a local wood said to harbour a Rake heard faint voices calling him, saw small sparkling orbs, and describes encounters with a green man presence.

270.summary: A couple lying awake heard a clear set of human footsteps climb the stairs to their bedroom door with no one there, following months of unexplained noises from the children's room.

271.place: Phoenix House classroom, South Parade, Leeds city centre
271.summary: During a sunny mid-morning training session the room and the street outside went dark as night for a moment before daylight snapped back; the witness, a colleague and the lecturer all noticed it.

272.place: Apartments near the Minack Theatre, Porthcurno, Cornwall
272.summary: On a windy night, a holidaymaker heard huge rhythmic wingbeats approach and seemingly settle outside his window, followed by shrieking; he says staff were also witnesses.

273.place: Track to a chicken farm by LKAB Minerals, west of Kilnwick near Driffield
273.summary: Waiting in his tractor at a tight bend, a farm worker watched a big black panther-like cat with a long low tail step out of a hedge, stop to look at him and retreat.

274.summary: After moving into a new flat, a woman heard footsteps creep up the hall and turned to see a black shape slip round a corner while her husband was in the kitchen; other odd incidents followed.

275.place: Model Farm fishing lake near Bewholme, between Hornsea and Skipsea
275.summary: At night a farmer saw a large bright light low over his fields; at dawn he photographed a hole punched through the clouds, shaped like an upturned wizard's hat, in the same spot.

276.place: Field beside the A165 between the Dotterel roundabout, Reighton and Muston
276.summary: Driving back to Scarborough, a couple saw a huge top-heavy creature run across a stubble field with an odd gorilla-like gait on all fours.

277.place: Above St Catherine's Lighthouse, Niton, Isle of Wight
277.summary: Walking towards the lighthouse at dusk, a man saw a bright white light hanging just above it which arced down and then shot out to sea at great speed.

278.place: Woods and farmland behind Boothferry Road, Hessle
278.summary: A night-time poacher in the late 1980s felt something large and unseen watching him in eerily silent woods after hearing a heavy branch snap, and never went out at night again.

279.place: Clifftop path just past Staple Newk, towards RSPB Bempton
279.summary: On a moonlit cliff walk, a man shone his torch over the edge and saw a pair of large round yellow eyes set unusually wide apart staring up from the cliff face before the unseen creature turned away.

280.place: Field gateway on the road from Tuxford towards Nottingham
280.summary: In 1985 three scooter riders passing through low mist at night saw a tall scarecrow-like figure with a grey grimacing face and hollow dark eyes in old gamekeeper clothing standing at a field gate.

281.place: Farm track through wheat off New Street, Deddington, Oxfordshire
281.summary: In July 1974 six children saw a 15ft silver disc with a dark window band glide towards them just above a wheat field with a low hum before it shot up into the sky.

282.place: Tea rooms on Frimley High Street, Surrey
282.summary: During a ghost investigation at reputedly haunted tea rooms, an investigator heard footsteps upstairs and later found what looks like a reaching hand in one low-light photo.

283.place: Field between Danes Dyke and Wold Farm, near Bempton
283.summary: An expanded account of report 215: walking with Paul Sinclair and his grandson, the witness describes a decaying smell Paul noticed, then the flat object gliding across the field and apparently vanishing into the ground where they had crossed the fence.

284.place: Roman-era field on the Yorkshire Wolds
284.summary: Metal detecting on a Roman site, a couple saw a distorted, heat-haze humanoid figure run past just as a silver coin was handed over; later visits brought nausea, roaring sounds and torch failures.

285.place: Roman Camp National Trust woodland, West Runton, Norfolk
285.summary: Two ex-servicemen wild camping heard pig-like grunting circle them; later something silently shoved the witness's tarp and brushed along his hammock, leaving him with unexplained fear.

286.place: Frimley, above the Golden Lake nature reserve, Surrey
286.summary: Arriving home in the early hours, a man filmed large bright white lights that slowly descended, blinked out and reappeared, at one point forming a triangle.

287.summary: In January 1967 a woman driving home saw two bright orange spheres towards Flamborough, followed them to Bempton and watched for twenty minutes until they descended into the sea about a mile out.

288.place: Drypool, east Hull, looking towards the Humber mouth
288.summary: Woken by a hovering search-and-rescue helicopter, a man saw a solid black triangle with white corner lights hanging still near it; when the searchlight found it the triangle vanished.

289.place: Back garden in Hayes, west London
289.summary: Around 2001 two boys woke to see a giant black wolf-like creature with a long snout, snarling teeth and pointed ears stroll across the lit garden and leap the fence.

290.place: North Park entrance at Cumberland Street, Darlington
290.summary: Two friends hiding from a feeling of being followed watched a van-sized translucent dark rectangle, like television static, glide between trees, fold up like a curtain and drift on while a street lamp dimmed.

292.place: Blue Bank on the A169, near RAF Fylingdales
292.summary: Early one morning a resident photographed a bright globular disc moving around near the sun before it travelled east towards the coast and disappeared.

293.place: Shaw near Rochdale, looking towards Saddleworth
293.summary: A couple watched a shiny silver ball sit in a clear sky, then drop, stop and dart left and right with instant starts before departing.

294.summary: In 1968 a six-year-old and her brothers watched a satin-sheened metallic sphere that seemed to follow her movements through the tree branches before rising silently and flying off.

295.place: Woodland on the old Loganlea pit bing, Addiewell, West Lothian
295.summary: Out running, a man saw a dark grey or black cat the size of a Labrador break cover onto the path, stare at him for a few seconds and vanish into the undergrowth.

296.place: Track down to Man Sands near Brixham, Devon
296.summary: In 1989 two friends walking to their tent at dusk heard heavy hooves before a 4.5ft creature with huge eyes dropped onto the track, growled and advanced when gravel was thrown at it.

297.place: Road from Wadworth to Tickhill, South Yorkshire
297.summary: Two young women driving home late repeatedly saw glowing white lights pace their car through the fields from Wadworth to Tickhill all summer; the witness and her father later saw an unknown craft near Stainton.

298.summary: Driving to work around 1999, a man passed an identical red car with his number plate and mismatched door, and its driver was himself, gasping back at him.

299.place: Bedroom of a home in West Yorkshire
299.summary: A woman who believed she was newly pregnant woke to three 3ft beings in her doorway telepathically telling her not to wake; weeks later she found a tiny chip-like object in an itchy lump on her wrist.

300.place: Servants' quarters behind the mansion on the Nugent estate, Portaferry, County Down
300.summary: In 1982 six family members lying in bed heard music, laughter and many conversations, like a grand ball, from the empty Georgian mansion next door before it faded to silence.

301.place: Back garden in Yatton, North Somerset
301.summary: Around 2007 a woman watched a shiny silver tic-tac shaped object hover beside a cloud for about half a minute, feeling observed, before it darted sideways behind the cloud.

302.summary: During a storm with silent sheet lightning, a couple in a campervan saw two orange-red balls of light hover about 20ft away for a few seconds, then a third; the next night Tim reports further oddities at the cliff viewpoint.

303.place: Ballyherly fishing lake on the Nugent estate, Portaferry
303.summary: Two friends camping by the lake saw an invisible something press bulges into their tent wall and roof that slid towards the open flap, yet nothing was outside in the moonlit field.

304.place: Woodland path beside the Nugent estate and Anne Street, Portaferry
304.summary: A walker saw a grapefruit-sized white-blue light weave playfully through bare branches; years later he saw a pillow-sized rugby-ball light glide low over the estate field.

305.place: Hunmanby Road just past the old Dotterel pub, Reighton
305.summary: A father and his daughter saw around six star-like lights moving oddly and shifting colour, and his partner filmed them on returning home.

306.place: Clyde Walkway behind Bothwell Castle, near Glasgow
306.summary: Walking his dogs on a Sunday afternoon, a man faced a featureless 7ft all-black figure clenching its fists in a clearing; his friends arrived and it vanished, with the dogs frozen in place.
